note: Private RV park behind the Auburn Inn Motel on US-75 at the north edge of Auburn, run with the motel. Gravel pull-through rows with concrete pads, laundry room, little shade; a rail line runs along the east side. Optimist Lake, a small pond with a fishing pier and trail, is across the street to the south. Takes overnight travelers and long-term stays. --Claude
